title.en: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven Regarding Public Works Projects for the Provinces of Negros Occidental and Lanao
title.orig: An Act to Amend Certain Items in Republic Act Numbered Fourteen Hundred Eleven Regarding Public Works Projects for the Provinces of Negros Occidental and Lanao

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_1625_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Under paragraph g, section two of the same Act, ”Negros Occidental", add the following items after "item Numbered fifty-five (a):
"55 (b) Municipal Building, Silay .........................
₱35,000" "55 (c) Medical Center and Maternity and Children's Hospital Building, Silay .........................
₱90,000" "55 (d) Rizal Civic and Cultural Center including purchase of equipment, Silay .........................
₱10,000" "55 (e) Public Market Building, Sitio Hawaiian, Silay .........................
₱10,000"

As a consequence of the above amendments, the total for paragraph "a", Title D of section one, and the total for paragraph "g" of section two of Republic Act Numbered One thousand four hundred eleven are correspondingly adjusted.

Item twelve, page four hundred seventy-three under sub-paragraph "z. Lanao" of section three of Republic Act Numbered One thousand four hundred eleven is hereby amended to read as follows:
"12.
Bacolod Grande Primary School Building, Bacolod—Construction ₱5,000,00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1957.
